note: THE SHELF's themes (iteration 005 S). Ordered: a FINISHED molecule goes to the FIRST theme whose `any` it carries (a theme with `app` also takes every molecule of the app's own table); `rest` takes what is left. A theme is ordered by the catalogue's `priority` and continues as 'TITLE · 2' past 5 GB of .lwm + .webp, with the next numeral. Titles and blurbs are data: rename them here. `numeral` is the theme's numeral when nothing before it splits.

themes.title: The Classics
themes.blurb: The molecules every chemistry book opens with, and every molecule of the app's own table.

themes.title: Medicine
themes.blurb: Medicines and the molecules the body answers to: painkillers, antibiotics, heart and mind, hormones and vitamins.

themes.title: Life and Food
themes.blurb: The chemistry of living things and of the kitchen: amino acids, sugars and fats, flavours and scents.

themes.title: Materials, Atmosphere and Fuel
themes.blurb: What things are made of and what the air carries: metals, plastics, solvents, fuels, gases and dyes.
